codeTrace.finding: Base opportunity upserts on project/company, assessedAt is replaced with now, then history is inserted unconditionally without a conflict target or semantic equality test.
Score components are then appended under the new history row.

opportunityHistory.expectedFingerprint: Canonical opportunity identity + model version + scores/dimensions + state/status/explanation + previous state + stable input snapshot (sorted signal/cluster IDs, ICP/pack/relationship versions); exclude assessedAt/updatedAt/runtime timestamps.

codeTrace.finding: Composition is deterministic, but the transaction only reads the latest integer version, clears current, and unconditionally inserts latest+1; no semantic hash/equality check exists.

whyVersion.expectedFingerprint: Opportunity ID + WHY rule/version + canonical status/text/claims/provenance references, with sorted arrays; exclude row ID, numeric version, current flag, and timestamps.

codeTrace.finding: snapshotKey includes opportunityAssessedAt and evidence observedAt. Re-evaluation changes opportunityAssessedAt, so semantically identical recommendations hash differently.
The unique conflict guard is present and works only when snapshotKey is stable; recommendedAt is output metadata and is not the primary cause.

recommendationLedger.expectedFingerprint: Stable company/project/opportunity/model/rule/config versions + scores/state + sorted signal/cluster/evidence IDs + WHY semantic fingerprint + recommended action; exclude assessment/observation/generation timestamps unless they represent a true changed source version.

separation.intelligenceSafety: Invalid facts/source roles and unsupported inferences.
separation.intelligenceRecall: Six extraction failures and two temporal failures after successful retrieval/evidence persistence.

recommendedFixOrder.scope: Correct atomic extraction for direct event evidence; prevent observation-date fallback for historical event facts; preserve buyer/seller role through evidence and fact validation.
Require explicit risk-program use of funds and implementation/change semantics rather than treating any funding event or generic technology mention as the named signal.
Add stable semantic fingerprints/change detection for opportunity history, WHY versions, and recommendation ledger snapshots.

finalDecision.label: MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_CORE_DEFECTS
finalDecision.reason: Recall is primarily broken after retrieval at extraction/temporal stages; signal safety includes both upstream input defects and a separate definition-level overreach; downstream replay duplication is an independent idempotency defect.
